what: the family of relative periodic orbits through the T* = 29.310 orbit (start values u1 u2 lam t of the perpendicular start of the orbit with rotation 0, t = half the period), traced in both directions in lam with tools/family-follow.mjs (30 minutes limit each, 8 pieces of the multiple shooting). points = accepted steps (T*, L* of the orbit, rotation angle theta and turns = theta in turns, closest approach, closure = rms mismatch after one period with the best rotation removed; word and largest multiplier every 5th step); zeros = members found with theta = 0 on the way; why = what stopped the trace (a stop is a limit of the method). The orbit is very unstable (multiplier 5e4 to 2e5 after L* about 1.03) and the closure of the accepted points gets worse than 1e-6; the rule that only the first stretch with closure below 1e-6 is used was added AFTER seeing this trace, so it is a choice made on the data: usable gives its range. The zeros in the part beyond it are not results.
